captions.text: Sign in with your username and PIN
On first run the shop must replace the PIN it was shipped with
The dashboard: today's rate, stock on hand, and what it is worth
Post the day's gold rate. Every price follows from it
Nothing is sold at a stored price — the rate drives every figure
Stock, priced live at the rate you just posted
Weight, purity and making charge per piece — no price is ever typed in
Ringing up a sale
Scan a tag, or type the item name
The bill builds itself: metal + making + wastage, at today’s rate
Take the payment
Complete the sale — the receipt prints and stock drops by one
The receipt, ready for the customer
Every finalised bill, searchable by day
A bill is never edited. A return is posted against it instead
Udhaar: who owes the shop, and what they have paid
Balances are built from an append-only ledger — every figure is explainable
What the books know that the counter cannot see
Profit split two ways: what you earned, and what the gold itself did
That second figure needs the rate on the bill against the rate you paid
No notebook can work that out. The app has kept both all along
And what is not selling — ranked by the cash asleep in it
Shop name, tax, rounding, staff and backups
Backups run automatically — on close, and before any upgrade
Jewel POS — offline, on one PC, with an audited trail
